propositions: The audit page renderer at page.py:329 computes `lacking` as `kind == "operator-attested" and not met`, which excludes `kind: "non-codebase"` criteria.
827 live COMPLETION_VERDICT events carry `kind: "operator-attested"` and are immutable; the renderer must accept both old and new kind values before schema changes.
page.py is the only site in the codebase comparing criterion `kind` against a string constant.
A criterion with `kind: "operator-attested"` and `met: false` must render with `lacking: true`.
A criterion with `kind: "non-codebase"` and `met: false` must render identically to the `operator-attested` case.
A criterion with `kind: "codebase-verifiable"` must remain unaffected regardless of the `lacking` logic changes.
